visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a bright retail space, a hand with pale skin reaches into a refrigerated metal display unit. The shelves are packed with clear plastic rectangular containers of sushi. Each box contains various colorful sushi rolls and nigiri, labeled with white price stickers. The lighting is uniform and bright. (2) The hand lifts a box of salmon sushi. The shot cuts to a countertop where multiple open containers of sushi are arranged. A large plate displays rows of glazed salmon nigiri with yellow and white sauce toppings. The background is a clean, slightly blurred store interior. (3) Close-up macro shots show chopsticks lifting individual sushi pieces. One piece of salmon has a charred, glistening surface with a yellow dollop of sauce. Another roll is topped with white sauce, orange roe, and green scallions. The person's hand is visible holding the sticks. (4) A transition occurs to a warm-lit display case holding golden fried chicken and rice balls. Tongs pick up a crispy chicken piece. A brown cardboard box contains assorted fried items: a drumstick and triangular rice balls. The setting remains inside the well-lit food shop. (5) The fried chicken leg is torn open, showing moist white meat and steam. The triangular rice ball is halved, revealing a dark meat filling. The focus is tight on the food texture. Yellow subtitles appear consistently at the bottom of the frame throughout. (6) The scene shifts to a wide shot of the store interior where a female customer in a green shirt browses. The walls have cartoon sushi art. Finally, the camera pans up to a circular outdoor sign with the brand's sushi character logo against a blue sky.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo, cheerful electronic BGM starts immediately with a 4/4 beat and bright synth chords. A male narrator begins speaking in a high-arousal, energetic tone with clear articulation. The vocal pitch is moderate and the delivery is rapid-fire, matching the quick visual cuts of sushi boxes. (2) As the narrator lists specific sushi flavors like truffle and caramel, the music remains constant. He maintains a friendly and persuasive tone with frequent rising intonations. There is no background noise; the mix is studio-clean with a high signal-to-noise ratio and bright spectral weight. (3) A slight shift occurs as the narration focuses on fried foods. The narrator's voice remains energetic, emphasizing words like 'crispy' and 'satisfying'. The synth-pop BGM continues with its bouncy rhythm. Occasional subtle 'whoosh' sound effects are used between scenes to emphasize the quick montage. (4) The final phase features a closing address from the 'Hooleefun' team. The narrator's pitch stays high and optimistic. The music reaches its final loop and fades out. The overall audio design is dense and optimized for social media consumption.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a promotional showcase for a creative sushi takeout store in Kaohsiung. It aims to attract customers by highlighting a wide variety of sushi choices, unique fusion toppings like truffle and caramel, and the addition of hot fried snacks, all presented with an energetic and appetizing vibe.
